from collections import defaultdict
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find smallest period p: each (c-r)%p class has a single nonzero value, and all classes covered
    for p in range(1, h+w):
        m=defaultdict(set)
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if g[r][c]: m[(c-r)%p].add(g[r][c])
        if len(m)==p and all(len(v)==1 for v in m.values()):
            mm={k:v.pop() for k,v in m.items()}
            return [[mm[(c-r)%p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
